Auto plain conversion with accessible names enabled

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["inlineDataMedia" => "AltTextOnly", "outputFormat" => "Plain", "tierStrategy" => "auto"]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convertWithAccessibleNames("<p><svg aria-label=\"Name\"><text>Drawn</text></svg></p>", true, $options);
var_dump($result->content);
```
